content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with a new [product_name] PLC. When I attempt to download using [product_name] [version_no] latest version, an error message appears. The PLC does not have a memory card installed, but I still receive this message. Are there any settings in the software or hardware I should adjust? [user_name]
Did you perhaps enable the 'Copy to SD card' option in the transfer settings window?
Thank you for your quick response. I will check and update soon.

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue was a download error while transferring a project to a new [product_name] PLC with [product_name] [version_no]. The problem was caused by enabling the 'Copy to SD card' feature without a memory card inserted. Users quickly identified and solved this common configuration error, with no ongoing frustrations or major usability concerns reported.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to transfer projects to new [product_name] PLCs seamlessly, without needing additional memory cards or encountering configuration errors.
